collision.root_cause_hypothesis: Create-only path uniqueness is scoped by caller-chosen research_id, so parallel workers can atomically create different paths for the same semantic candidate/objective before search/index visibility converges.
collision.coordination_implication: The deterministic semantic-objective fingerprint hypothesis in R6-BLOCKER-REUSE-HYPOTHESIS-HANDOFF remains strongly supported as a coordination design target; this reconciliation does not itself promote that hypothesis to implementation credit.

complementary_source_evidence.finding: The backwards-compatible obj.save() path uses a C extension that mutates Python's base object type globally and remains mounted for the process lifetime. NNsight itself recommends the plain nnsight.save() function; CONFIG.APP.PYMOUNT=False can disable the global method injection.
complementary_source_evidence.f2_transfer: If NNsight reaches a later isolated local fixture, disable PYMOUNT and prefer nnsight.save() so the intervention harness changes less interpreter-global state.

complementary_source_evidence.finding: The upstream repository contains a benchmark harness explicitly comparing NNsight intervention/save overhead against raw PyTorch register_forward_hook across layer count, token count and module type.
complementary_source_evidence.f2_transfer: Reuse the benchmark shape only. Upstream timings are not F2 evidence; a later E3/E4 fixture must compare pinned NNsight against a minimal native-hook baseline on the exact target model/runtime.

complementary_source_evidence.finding: The base install pulls torch, transformers, accelerate, HTTP/socket clients, pydantic, IPython, rich, cloudpickle and zstandard among other dependencies.
complementary_source_evidence.f2_transfer: Treat full-library adoption as resource-expensive relative to a narrow WP507 falsifier; structural/native distillation remains the baseline competitor.

fused_adjudication.next_discriminator: Under an independently non-colliding E2 objective, compare pinned NNsight, pyvene, TransformerLens and minimal native PyTorch hooks against the exact WP507 G3 identity/provenance contract; require loader identity preservation, sham/random-layer/equal-norm/rescue controls, fail-closed shape/path/generation errors, and resource/latency measurements before any E3/E4/E5 promotion.
